<a id="wiki-9463"></a>

# OW2 Workshop Changes/Bugs

Source: [9463](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/9463); edited 2026-08-13. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-9463-n1"></a>

- Documented duplicate mode names can represent 5v5/6v6/LTM variants with different supported settings; text import may fail when settings target the wrong variant. Map numeric suffix denotes time/variant; omitting it enables all variants.

<a id="wiki-9463-n2"></a>

- Workshop Setting categories are alphabetic, and nonzero Workshop String Combo default reportedly makes first UI choice unselectable.

<a id="wiki-9463-n3"></a>

- Season 16 export reportedly changes On/Off hero settings to Enabled/Disabled that cannot be reimported without correction; Juno Glide Boost Duration Scalar is omitted by copying settings.

<a id="wiki-9463-n4"></a>

- Ability Cooldown reads reportedly return 0 for Baptiste field, Soldier helix, Tracer recall, Genji dash, D.Va missiles, Lifeweaver dash and charge abilities including Reinhardt, Zarya, Tracer, Sojourn with Dual Thrusters, Symmetra, Junkrat and Brigitte. Reading and setting support must be distinguished.

<a id="wiki-9463-n5"></a>

- Ultimates Used statistic reportedly excludes Reinhardt, Roadhog, Sombra, Torbjorn, Widowmaker and Kiriko; Echo's own duplication is excluded but copied ultimates outside that list count.

<a id="wiki-9463-n6"></a>

- Roadhog Ability 1 cooldown starts on input then restarts at cast-animation end; his Ability 2 is reportedly undetectable by Is Using Ability 2.

<a id="wiki-9463-n7"></a>

- Sojourn secondary-fire disabling uses Railgun alt fire setting; Mercy blaster is clip 0; Hanzo/Zenyatta Ability 1 and 2 reportedly swap on console; Lifeweaver Is Reloading always false.

<a id="wiki-9463-n8"></a>

- Reduced-max-health heroes may resurrect above their max; suggested workaround clamps current health to Max Health. Ramattra alternate-form query reportedly fails; possible substitute uses Is Using Ability 1 or ultimate depending on context.

<a id="wiki-9463-n9"></a>

- Illari secondary resource read/write is inverted (percentage missing rather than filled).

<a id="wiki-9463-n10"></a>

- Ammo matrix (13 Aug 2026) distinguishes writes from reads: most listed heroes can Set Ammo and read ammo/max but cannot Set Max Ammo. Exceptions include Jetpack Cat/Wuyang unable to set either but readable; D.mon pilot and Mauga unable to read/write either; Juno/Kiriko/Lifeweaver/Orisa/Shion can set ammo but neither read value nor set max; Mizuki/Venture can set both but read neither.

<a id="wiki-9463-n11"></a>

- Specific ammo caveats: Anran secondary cannot read/set; Bastion Set Max Ammo only affects unused secondary clip; D.mon Set Ammo disables both forms' primary and Fusion Repeater; Doomfist above default 4 displays overfill/odd animation; Kiriko clip 0 write affects clip 1; Lifeweaver both weapons affected; Orisa hidden ammo acts as heat, regenerates at constant rate.

<a id="wiki-9463-n12"></a>

- Cooldown-setting matrix (27 May 2026): Anran/Freja charge cooldown changes only below 2 charges; Brigitte Repair Pack/D.Va Ability 2/Emre Ability 2/Junkrat Ability 1/Lifeweaver manual-swap Ability 1/Symmetra Ability 1/Soldier Ability 1 are marked unsupported; Brigitte and Junkrat charges can be changed instead.

<a id="wiki-9463-n13"></a>

- Genji dash, Soldier secondary, Ramattra Omnic secondary need existing cooldown for valid changes; off-cooldown Genji/Soldier setting may change display only. Symmetra teleporter cooldown cannot change in use (also hovering barrier). Mercy Flash Heal unsupported. Mizuki Healing Kasa on two charges can enter cooldown without displaying it. Reinhardt Fire Strike/Shield Slam and Zarya barriers setters work despite charges. Zenyatta abilities lack normal cooldowns and cannot be given one.

<a id="wiki-9463-n14"></a>

- Set Ability Resource table lists Doomfist (button uncertain), Orisa primary (use ammo), Sojourn/Hazard/Wuyang secondary as unsupported.

<a id="wiki-9463-n15"></a>

- Event Ability null-read table lists primary for Anran, D.Va mech, Junker Queen, Mauga, Ramattra Omnic, Venture, Wuyang; secondary for Mauga, Kiriko, Lifeweaver. A separate Event Ability Bugs article is linked.

<a id="wiki-9463-n16"></a>

- Is Waiting For Players reportedly always false during client-side visual evaluation; workaround mirrors it to a global variable in a server rule.

<a id="wiki-9463-n17"></a>

- Conditions depending on chased variables reportedly do not update until chase destination is reached, including Wait Until; indefinite chase may never trigger a waiting rule.

<a id="wiki-9463-n18"></a>

- Create Projectile/Create Homing Projectile with non-null owner reportedly leak entity slots if owner leaves or is swapped before projectile expires; projectile vanishes visually but Entity Count does not recover. Suggested alternatives are null ownership or custom logic with Create Projectile Effect.

<a id="wiki-9463-n19"></a>

- Disable Game Mode In-World UI does not remove Push-robot icon. Good Beam is replaced by Nemesis Mercy damage beam and ignores color; outlines may require character reload and may fade after actions.

<a id="wiki-9463-n20"></a>

- Other archived compatibility notes: unavailable seasonal templates; Route 66 FFA/TDM but not Bounty Hunter; Havana TDM unavailable; changed HUD centering/IWT anchoring/fonts, vague Small Message rendering issues.

<a id="wiki-9463-n21"></a>

- Season 3 editor/Inspector issues include search focus, array display overlap, stuck overlapping menus, editing crashes and spurious settings-letter paste error; recreating lobby is suggested for the paste error.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/9463.md).

Source limitations:

- This is a rolling mixed-era bug registry, not an independently verified current specification. Table-level dates differ from page timestamp and some sections explicitly refer to Season 3/Season 16.

- Event Ability table claims July 2024 update while containing newer-looking entries; preserve uncertainty rather than infer current support.

- Ammo table duplicates Junkerqueen/Junker Queen; malformed cooldown table separator has an extra column.

- 'Heroes not in table work fine' claims must not be generalized to future/untested heroes.

- Suggested workarounds are not all guaranteed; Ramattra substitution is explicitly possible, projectile options attempted, and Doomfist resource button unknown.
